summary: Mimir Wave 18 P1: mimirClient.ts, config env vars, and .env.example added.
details: Created MimirClient with OAuth2 client_credentials token caching (60s early refresh), 15s fetch timeouts, structured warn logging, and six API methods returning graceful empty/null on error. Added MIMIR_* env vars to EnvSchema and documented them in .env.example. Verified with `npx tsc --noEmit` from backend/ (exit 0).
